match: IPL 2025 final, 3 June 2025: Royal Challengers Bengaluru (batting_team_id 5) batted first, made 190 for 9 in 20 overs and beat Punjab Kings by 6 runs
how_checked: Checked by hand without the superr package: ball_by_ball.csv was read with Python's csv module and the 129 rows with match_id 40767 and innings 1 were kept.
extras_type is None on 120 rows and wide on 9 rows, so the innings holds 120 Legal_Balls, 9 Wides and no No_Ball (other or Overstep), bye, leg-bye or Penalty Delivery.
runs (the bat runs) sums to 181 over the 129 rows and is 0 on each Wide. extras_2_runs is 0 on every row.
Under every candidate Extras_Encoding (E1-E4) a plain Legal_Ball scores b + e = b and a Wide scores 1 + e = 1, so the total is 181 + 9 x 1 = 190 (design finding F-11).

The published scorecard agrees: Royal Challengers Bengaluru 190 for 9 (ESPNcricinfo match report, https://www.espncricinfo.com/series/ipl-2025-1449924/punjab-kings-vs-royal-challengers-bengaluru-final-1473511/match-report).
